criteria.text: Logon time for a standard user is under the agreed target, measured on a normal morning
criteria.how: Measure logon times for a test group over a week.

criteria.text: An image update reaches every pool in one change, with a rollback
criteria.how: Update a test image, roll it out, then roll back one pool.

criteria.text: A user on a personal device reaches their desktop with strong sign-in, and no data stays on the device
criteria.how: Sign in from an unmanaged device and check what is left on it.

criteria.text: A peak of extra users is served by new desktops within the agreed time
criteria.how: Simulate a peak and time the new desktops coming up.

criteria.text: The cost per user per month is known and compared with today's
criteria.how: Compute the figure with the customer's own numbers.
